cases.title: Brahmagupta's balanced four-variable identity
cases.description: A universal degree-four identity in four independent natural-number variables, proved from its statement in five native steps. The 4abcd term is essential: this balanced form alone does not prove closure of sums of two squares. Hybrid v4 and v5 both proved it; the published record is the v5 run, followed by a fresh independent native replay. No model or Vampire call was needed.
cases.theorem: forall a b c d. (a * a + b * b) * (c * c + d * d) + 4 * a * b * c * d = (a * c + b * d) * (a * c + b * d) + (a * d + b * c) * (a * d + b * c)
